name: io.httpfy/httpfy
title: HTTPfy network & DNS tools
description: Free DNS, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, TLS, WHOIS, IP/ASN, blocklist, ping, traceroute and port checks. No key.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Look up DNS records of one type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SOA, TXT, SRV) for a domain using public resolvers.

tools.name: dns_propagation_check
tools.description: Query a domain's A or NS records on about 30 well-known public resolvers (all queried from httpfy.io's server; anycast resolvers answer from their nearest site) and report each resolver's answer, NXDOMAIN, NODATA or failure, to see whether a DNS change has propagated. CDN and GeoDNS names can legitimately differ between resolvers.

tools.name: dnssec_check
tools.description: Inspect a domain's DNSSEC chain from the root down: DS and DNSKEY records per zone, whether each DS matches a published key, signature expiry, and whether validating resolvers (Cloudflare, Google) treat the domain as secure, insecure or bogus. Signatures are judged by those resolvers, not recomputed.

tools.name: mx_lookup
tools.description: List the mail exchanger (MX) records of a domain with their preferences, detect null MX (RFC 7505) and implicit MX, and flag MX targets that are CNAMEs, IP literals or do not resolve.

tools.name: spf_lookup
tools.description: Fetch the SPF record of a domain from its authoritative name server and list its mechanisms (ip4, ip6, include, redirect, all).

tools.name: spf_validate
tools.description: Validate the SPF record of a domain: RFC 7208 syntax, single-record rule, DNS lookup count across includes and redirect (limit 10, a static estimate), void lookups, include loops and the all mechanism.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Registration data for a domain via RDAP (port-43 WHOIS as fallback): registrar, dates, status and name servers (personal contact data is redacted by registries).

tools.name: domain_expiry
tools.description: Registration and expiry dates of a domain (RDAP, WHOIS fallback), with the time remaining before it expires or how long ago it expired.

tools.name: ssl_certificate_check
tools.description: Connect to a domain on port 443 and report a validity verdict (valid, expired, hostname mismatch, self-signed, untrusted, with the reason) plus the certificate chain: subject, SANs, issuer, validity dates, days remaining, TLS version and cipher. Revocation is not checked.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Ping a public host from httpfy servers (4 ICMP echo requests) and report packet loss and round-trip times. Useful to test reachability from outside your own network.

tools.name: traceroute
tools.description: Traceroute to a public host from httpfy servers (up to 15 hops, one probe per hop; partial results are returned if the time limit is reached). Internal hops of httpfy's own network are masked.

tools.name: ip_whois
tools.description: Registry data (RDAP) for a public IPv4 or IPv6 address: network range, holder organisation, abuse contact, registry and the announcing ASN.

ip_address.description: IP Address (Enter IPv4 or IPv6 address)

tools.name: ip_blacklist_check
tools.description: Check whether a public IPv4 address is listed on about 20 DNS-based blocklists such as Barracuda and SpamCop, showing listed, not listed or not checked (with the reason) per list.

tools.name: mac_vendor_lookup
tools.description: Identify the manufacturer registered for a MAC address prefix (OUI) using the IEEE registry.

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.description: Look up the autonomous system (ASN) for a public IP address, details for an ASN such as AS15169 (name, country, announced prefixes and address counts), or find ASNs by network name such as Cloudflare.

query.description: IP address, ASN or network name (8.8.8.8, AS13335 or Cloudflare)

tools.name: bimi_check
tools.description: Check the BIMI record of a domain, whether DMARC meets BIMI requirements, the SVG logo (SVG Tiny PS checks) and the VMC/CMC certificate (validity dates, domain coverage, BIMI usage); the certificate chain is not verified.

tools.name: caa_check
tools.description: Find the CAA records that apply to a domain (climbing to parent domains per RFC 8659) and list which certificate authorities may issue certificates.

tools.name: certificate_transparency_search
tools.description: List certificates logged in Certificate Transparency for a domain (via crt.sh): issuer, validity window and names, with a summary by issuer. Source: crt.sh, with SSLMate Cert Spotter as a fallback when crt.sh is slow (Cert Spotter covers unexpired certificates only).

tools.name: dkim_check
tools.description: Check DKIM public keys for a domain. With a selector it checks that selector; without one it probes common selectors. Reports key type and RSA key length and flags weak or revoked keys.

tools.name: dmarc_check
tools.description: Find and explain the DMARC record of a domain (policy, pct, rua/ruf, alignment) and flag weaknesses such as p=none or missing external report authorization.

tools.name: dns_report
tools.description: Full DNS report for a domain: delegation from the root, every authoritative name server checked individually (reachability, recursion, TCP, consistency), SOA values, MX records and their reverse DNS, SPF, DMARC, DKIM and DNSSEC.

tools.name: domain_health_report
tools.description: Grade a domain A to F across 11 checks (name servers, SOA, DNSSEC, MX, SPF, DMARC, CAA, HTTPS certificate, HTTP to HTTPS redirect, HSTS, IPv6), with a reason and fix for each failed check.

tools.name: mta_sts_check
tools.description: Check MTA-STS (TXT record and the HTTPS policy file, mode and MX patterns) and the TLS-RPT reporting record for a domain.

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Check whether one TCP port on a public host is open, closed or filtered when tested from httpfy servers on the internet.

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem with this httpfy MCP server to the people who maintain it: a tool you needed that does not exist, a tool that failed or returned wrong or outdated data, or a tool or argument that was confusing. Use it only after an httpfy tool fell short, at most once per task, and keep working on the user's request afterwards. Say what you tried, what happened, what you expected, and if you can, the change that would fix it. Include the domain or IP the check was about when it matters, but no secrets, credentials or personal data. A human reads every report; no reply is sent. Not for testing the server or logging progress.

task.description: Short phrase naming what the user asked for, e.g. 'check why mail from example.com goes to spam'.

kind.description: missing_tool: no tool for what was needed. wrong_result: data looked wrong or outdated. error: the tool failed. confusing: unclear tool, argument or output. idea: anything else.

impact.description: blocked: could not finish. worked_around: finished another way. friction: finished, but it was harder than it should be.

tool_name.description: The httpfy tool the report is about. Leave out for missing_tool or general ideas.

description.description: What you tried (tool and arguments), what happened (error text or the wrong part of the output) and what you expected.

proposed_fix.description: Optional: the concrete change that would have helped (new tool, argument, output field, wording).
